name: Human
summary: Across the Eastern Kingdoms, humans still defend their place among the mortal realms. Their old empire broke into seven kingdoms. Now Stormwind is their strongest realm and the Alliance’s chief human power.

sections.title: The Empire of Arathor
sections.body:
Long ago, human tribes wandered apart beneath the threat of the Amani forest trolls. Warlord Thoradin of the Arathi saw that division would bring their end. Through diplomacy and conquest, he united the clans and founded the Empire of Arathor, with its fortress capital at Strom.

During the Troll Wars, the beleaguered high elves of Quel'Thalas allied with Arathor. They taught one hundred humans the arts of arcane magic. Together, humans and high elves broke the troll armies. Arathor secured human rule over the central continents, and the alliance laid the ground for future ties among mortal peoples.

sections.title: Fracture into Seven Kingdoms
sections.body:
As Arathor grew secure and prosperous, its distant settlements became powerful city-states, able to stand alone. In time, the empire split into seven realms: Gilneas, Alterac, Dalaran, Lordaeron, Kul Tiras, Stormwind, and Stromgarde, whose first home was Strom.

These kingdoms traded with dwarves, gnomes, and elves, yet peace remained fragile. Border clashes and claims over land stirred rivalries, including old mountain feuds between Alterac and Stromgarde. Court intrigue added to the strain. The kingdoms stayed divided until disasters beyond their borders forced them to act together.

sections.title: Invasion and Ruin
sections.body:
The orcish Horde came through the Dark Portal, forcing humanity’s kingdoms to face a common enemy. Stormwind fell in the First War, and its refugees fled north to warn the other realms. King Terenas Menethil II helped forge the Alliance of Lordaeron, joining humans, dwarves, gnomes, and high elves against the Horde in the Second War.

Stormwind was rebuilt with great effort. Then the Scourge plague ravaged Lordaeron, and Dalaran fell during the Third War. The northern human realms lay in smoking ruin.

sections.title: A Precarious Present
sections.body:
Stormwind is the strongest human kingdom left and the heart of the grand Alliance. King Varian Wrynn vanished while traveling to a diplomatic summit. His ten-year-old son, Anduin Wrynn, was crowned king, with Highlord Bolvar Fordragon as regent.

Northward, Lordaeron’s survivors are scattered or dead. Gilneas remains behind its colossal Greymane Wall, leaving Stormwind to carry the burden of humanity’s defense.

faq.q: What were the Seven Kingdoms of humanity?
faq.answer: The Seven Kingdoms were Lordaeron, Stormwind, Stromgarde, Dalaran, Kul Tiras, Gilneas, and Alterac. They arose when the Empire of Arathor fractured into independent city-states, each with its own ways and strengths.

faq.q: Where did humans originally come from?
faq.answer: Humans began as nomadic tribes roaming the forests and highlands of the northern Eastern Kingdoms, especially around Tirisfal Glades. They later united under Warlord Thoradin as the first human nation.

faq.q: What happened to the kingdom of Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Lordaeron was devastated by the Scourge’s plague of undeath during the Third War, and its prince, Arthas Menethil, betrayed it. Its ruined capital and nearby lands are now contested by the undead Forsaken, the Scourge, and remnants such as the Scarlet Crusade.

faq.q: Who currently rules humanity and Stormwind?
faq.answer: With King Varian Wrynn missing under suspicious circumstances, his young son Anduin Wrynn holds the throne as a figurehead. Highlord Bolvar Fordragon rules as Regent alongside royal advisor Lady Katrana Prestor.

faq.q: Why did the high elves teach humans magic?
faq.answer: During the Troll Wars, the high elves of Quel'Thalas faced annihilation by the Amani trolls. They made a treaty with Thoradin, ruler of Arathor, trading lessons in arcane magic for one hundred human soldiers.

faq.q: What role did humans play in forming the Alliance?
faq.answer: After Stormwind fell to the orcs in the First War, human refugees rallied the northern kingdoms. Under King Terenas of Lordaeron and Lord Lothar of Stormwind, human realms joined Ironforge dwarves, gnomes, and high elves to form the Alliance of Lordaeron.
Humans train as warriors, paladins, hunters, rogues, priests, mages, and warlocks.

angles.text: As a human, you inherit the legacy of fallen Arathor and ruined Lordaeron. Stormwind now bears the defense and survival of the mortal realms.
Human diplomacy and resolve forged the Alliance of Lordaeron. Stormwind remains the faction’s political and military heart.
Human wizardry began in the Troll Wars, when the high elves taught the first one hundred human mages. Their teaching led in time to the founding of Dalaran.
Human holy men and knights founded the Knights of the Silver Hand in Lordaeron to fight the horrors of the Second War.
Humans were the first enemies the orcs met after crossing the Dark Portal. Their meeting began three brutal wars for survival on Azeroth.
